trends.raw_quote: At this point it feels less like a neighborhood and more like some weird suburban dictatorship run by people with too much free time and no life. I listed this place for sale and we have a lot of viewers. But the second buyers hear strict HOA, you can practically see them mentally checking out.
trends.problem_summary: HOA leadership changed and implemented increasingly restrictive rules — trees removed (no shade), cats can't go outside, dogs can't bark, kids can't play in front yards, guests parking = $20 fee. Homeowner can't sell because buyers run when they hear 'strict HOA'.
pillars: Understand your HOA documents and what the board can and cannot legally enforce
How to diplomatically challenge or vote out a rogue HOA board
Strategic disclosure and presentation when selling a home with a difficult HOA

trends.raw_quote: I'm butting heads with my teen all day long. It's exhausting but I'm not surprised, he's always been strong-willed. I got so tired of spanking and spanking and I never managed to conquer her will.
trends.problem_summary: Parents are locked in constant power struggles with strong-willed children, exhausting themselves trying to 'break' a will that isn't actually strong — the child lacks will-muscle, not has too much of it. Traditional advice makes things worse.
pillars: Reframe 'strong-willed' — what the term gets wrong and what it actually signals
The Charlotte Mason approach: atmosphere, habit, and ideas instead of power struggles
Practical daily strategies: the Low Calm Voice method and building self-restraint as a muscle

trends.raw_quote: Really frustrated with the inspection result on this brand new home. Dad worried about foundation poured by contractor. Homeowner refused to pay the extra $500 for subfloor rot repairs.
trends.problem_summary: Homeowners face shocking foundation repair bills ($2,000-$45,000 range), don't know how to assess if contractor quotes are fair, and discover hidden problems only during escrow inspections.
pillars: How to read a foundation inspection report without being a structural engineer
What drives foundation repair costs — and how to get non-biased quotes
Negotiating repair credits vs. requiring repairs before closing

scores_note: 2 trends > 8/10: hoa-survival-guide (8.5) and strong-willed-child-guide (8.0). Foundation guide (7.5) will proceed as secondary product.
